senses.gloss:
हीन- + अङ्ग हीन- + अङ्ग (vb. 2. हा),
 I. adj. maimed, Man. 4, 141.
 II. f. गी, an ant.
हीन- + कर्मन् हीन- + कर्मन्, adj. neglecting religious acts.
हीन- + क्रिय हीन- + क्रिय (vb. हा), adj. one who neglects his religious duties, Man. 3, 7.
हीन- + जाति हीन- + जाति (vb. हा), adj. being of the lowest class, Man. 3, 15; degraded, outcaste.
हिंसा- + प्राय हिंसा- + प्राय, adj., f. या, abundant in injury (to living beings), Man. 10, 83.
हीन- + वाद हीन- + वाद (vb. हा), m. contradictory evidence, prevarication.
हीन- + वादिन् हीन- + वादिन् (vb. हा), adj. (speaking deficiently), 1. dumb. 2. contradictory. 3. inadmissible (as evidence). 4. cast in law, Pañc. 166, 18.
हिंसा- + विहार हिंसा- + विहार, m. roaming with the intention to do mischief, Rām. 3, 51, 20.
हीन-दर्शन- + सामर्थ्य हीन-दर्शन- + सामर्थ्य (vb. का), adj. blind, Rājat. 5, 219.
हीन- + सेवा हीन- + सेवा (vb. हा), f. serving a low person, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 3355.

हिंस् हिंस् (an anomal. desider. of हन्), i. 1, and ii. 7, हिनस्, हिंस्, Par.
 1. To strike, Bhaṭṭ. 17, 13.
 2. To hurt, Man. 7, 73.
 3. To kill, Man. 5, 42.
 4. To destroy, Vikr. d. 16; Pañc. i. d. 342.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. हिंसित, n. Injury, Pañc. v. d. 70.
 --Caus., or i. 10, Par. To kill, MBh. 3, 13030.
 --With आ आ, To kill, Man. 7, 20, v. r.
 --With उप उप,
 1. To hurt, Man. 7, 73.
 2. To injure, Man. 11, 26.
 --With प्रति प्रति, प्रतिहिंसित, n. Requital of an injury, Pañc. v. d. 70.
 --With वि वि,
 1. To injure, Rām. 2, 56, 39, Seramp.
 2. To damage (grain), Man. 8, 238.

हिंसक हिंस् + अक,
 I. adj.
 1. Mischievous, injurious, noxious, Pañc. iii. d. 106.
 2. One who has injured, Pañc. i. d. 342.
 II. m.
 1. A beast of prey.
 2. An enemy.
 3. A Brāhmaṇa skilled [] in the Atharva-Veda (cf. हिंसा).
 --Comp.

हिंसन हिंस् + अन, n.
 1. Slaying, Man. 10, 78
 2. Injury, ib. 2, 177.

हिंसा हिंस् + आ, f.
 1. Injuring, Man. 8, 255; injury, mischief, Rām. 3, 51, 20.
 2. Spoiling, Man. 11, 63.
 3. Incantation; in हिंसा-कर्मन्, Employment of mystical texts for malevolent purposes.
 4. Killing, murder, Bhāg. P. 2, 6, 8; Pañc. 60, 6.
 --Comp.
हिंसारु हिंसा + रु, m. A tiger.
हिंसालु हिंसा + लु, adj. Mischievous.

हिंसालुक हिंसालु + क,
 I. adj. Mischievous.
 II. m. A mischievous dog.

हिंसीर हिंसीर (vb. हिंस्), m.
 1. A tiger.
 2. A villain.

हिंस्र हिंस् + र,
 I. adj.
 1. One who delights in mischief, Man. 3, 164; mischievous, destroying, Man. 9, 310.
 2. Terrible.
 3. Cruel, Hit. ii. d. 174.
 II. m.
 1. A beast of prey, Ragh. 2, 62.
 2. Śiva.
 III. f. रा.
 1. A vein.
 2. The name of three plants.
 --Comp.
हिंस्र-अ- + हिंस्र हिंस्र-अ- + हिंस्र, n. noxious and innocent, Man. 1, 29.
हिन्दोल हिन्दोल, and हिन्दोलक हिन्दोल + क, m. A swing (cf. दुल्, अन्दोलय), Śṛṅgārat. 9.
† हिन्दोलय हिन्दोलय (a denomin. derived from हिन्दोल), Par. To swing.
† हिन्व् हिन्व्, i. 1, Par. To satisfy or please (cf. धिन्व्).
ऽहीनक -हीन + क (vb. 2. हा), in करपादैक-, i. e. कर-पाद-एक-, adj. Losing a hand and a foot, Yājñ. 2, 274.

ऽहीनत्व -हीन + त्व (vb. 2. हा), in उत्साह-शक्ति-, n. Want of the power of exertion, Hit. iv. d. 36. पुत्र-, n. Condition of having no son, Cāṇ. 49 in Berl. Monatsb. 1864, 410. बुद्धि-, n. Want of understanding. Hit. ii. d. 99.
